dispatchComparison.limitation: Route predicates are statically expanded; non-route authorization/data branches may have multiple return sites for one operation.

comparison.limitation: Literal operation comparison and independent review complement each other; dynamic expressions and branch gates remain in the source closure, not presumed executed.

limitations: Symbol reachability overapproximates conditional branches, including public RootLayout. Actual conditional rendering and auth require runtime evidence.
Operation text preserves query/template expressions; it is not an inferred runtime URL or response shape.
Type-only declarations do not prove serializers or decoders.
